verdict.rationale: Unreal's first-party Python editor scripting is documented for automating repetitive, time-consuming asset management tasks such as generating LODs for Static Meshes, automating actor placement and settings across levels, and building asset pipelines. The cook commandlet also processes multiple platforms and maps in a single command, and Remote Control can drive editor functions programmatically. Missing for 10: an explicit dedicated bulk-edit or batch-operation feature beyond scripting, documented examples of operating over large asset selections, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
